program: Glasses, hearing and dentures within PHC's full portfolio

nutshell.headline: Low-cost corrective care can help, but ordinary PHC giving supports much more than glasses.
nutshell.body: Conditional central cost is $798,863 donor and $1,118,409 gross resources per10SF QALYs. The historical $71,111 result was glasses-program-only, not an ordinary gift estimate.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: Core Senses and partners help people complete optical, hearing and denture care that existing coverage may fail to deliver.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: Allocation, costs, current additional capacity, patient alternatives and utility transfer are assumptions. General giving is not restricted to a cheap device.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: No current project-level marginal funding offer verified. Conditional research estimate, not a funding recommendation.

programSection.body: Only three care-completion health streams are quantified. Drop-in services, basic dental treatment, IDs, hygiene, meals and broader navigation retain cost; their unmeasured health is not asserted absent.

steps.title: Allocate ordinary support
steps.detail: Complete pathway cash costs include delivery failure and allocated sponsor/administrative support.

steps.title: Bound additional capacity
steps.detail: New completed episodes are limited by funding replacement and explicit annual caps.

steps.title: Deduplicate patient health
steps.detail: Assign one primary clinical stream per patient-year; no second generic-utility gain for a person already credited elsewhere.

steps.title: Count finite incremental use
steps.detail: Only useful correction for at most one year after delayed care starts (up to1.25 gift-years), beyond equivalent insured/charity care; subtract independent and episode harms.

programSection.boundary: PHC project-directed general gifts via Community Initiatives, not sponsor-wide unrestricted giving. No saved lives or employment/housing conversion.

model.headline: The whole gift buys an uncertain portfolio, not 1,000 extra glasses pairs
model.body: The central $100k budget supports133.33 nominal glasses,6.67 hearing and10 denture episodes before funding/capacity adjustments. Remaining$55k has no added quantified clinical stream.

equation.label: Whole gift health
equation.expression: Each Q = min(gift×allocation/cash cost×funding additionality, capacity) × nonoverlap share × no-equivalent-alternative share × signed utility × effective finite discounted years − episode harms; sum pathways minus independent harm.

model.giftHeading: Every dollar of the $100,000 PHC gift remains in the numerator

inputs.label: Allocation
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Analyst prior, not financial observation; ranges5–40%/0–20%/0–25% subject sum≤1. Current PHC project accounts unavailable. No general-gift restriction inferred.

inputs.label: Cash unit
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Completed appropriate dispense/fitting/denture episode; includes all recruitment failures, examinations funded by PHC, follow-up, navigation, allocated sponsor fee/admin. Glasses/denture fundraising examples $50/$1,000 are incomplete-cost fundraising anchors, not proven lower bounds, not invoices; hearing cost is prior. Ranges$75–300/$750–3000/$1000–3000.

inputs.label: Outside resources
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Prior$0–300/$0–2000/$0–2000. Partner/insured clinical care, donated labor, devices and patient time not already donor-paid. Gross associated resource envelope, no public offsets.

inputs.label: Funding and capacity
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.best: 50% funding additionality; caps100/5/8 additional completed episodes in one year
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Priors. Financial replacement separate from patient alternatives. Caps plausible bounded absorption, not a quoted offer or current queue. Actual verified room null; cap0 diagnostic.

inputs.label: No overlapping people
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.best: Primary health ledger: glasses first, then hearing excluding glasses recipients, dentures excluding both
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Shares1/.8/.8 are analyst fractions of completed episodes in disjoint patient-year cohorts. For discarded overlapping people, all costs and procedural harms remain; no second generic-utility credit. Actual identity linkage unavailable.

inputs.label: Utility
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Signed preference-utility priors while effectively corrected. External glasses before/after .075 in41/113 follow-ups, not causal full-cohort effect. Hearing and denture randomized symptom/oral results are not directly QALYs. Ranges-.02–.075 /-.02–.05 /-.02–.08. No separate social/mental-health score credit.

inputs.label: Finite health
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.best: At most one benefit year after delayed care starts; effective use .75/.6/.7; delay .1/.25/.25 years
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Priors for wear/fit/breakage within the year after care starts and delayed access, no multiyear extrapolation. Fraction without equivalent alternative correction during the year .7/.7/.6; remaining receive zero credit. Do not reapply referral-completion probability to completed-unit costs.

inputs.label: Public baseline
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.best: Medi-Cal optical, hearing and dental services plus public/charity partners continue
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Coverage/eligibility vary; not all PHC participants have accessible care. Dental changes across official pages have inconsistent dates; no unsupported eligibility-specific treatment effect is inferred.

inputs.label: Harm
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.best: Per added completed episode .0002/.001/.002 QALY; independent0
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Gift-date PV losses beyond signed durable utility. Charged on every additional completed episode before patient overlap/alternative filters; conservative since alternative-treatment harms not subtracted. Includes repeated fittings; no activity multiplier for independent harm.

inputs.label: Geography
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Nested recipient-health residence priors, not observed addresses. Same denominators; never sum nested QALYs.

inputs.label: Other portfolio outside resources
inputs.confidence: Explicit prior unless source states otherwise
inputs.range: Ranges and structural limits in basis; scenarios below
inputs.basis: Explicit allowance for donated/partner inputs to otherwise unquantified activities, beyond donor-paid55% remainder. Not sponsor-wide accounts or a measured marginal external cost.

model.uncertaintyBoundary: Central exceeds $100k; joint favorable total $80,303/10SF QALYs is a real conditional upside, not a confidence bound or a funding quote. Zero and harm retain gift cost and suppress positive ratios.
model.fundingBoundary: Public clinical/insurance and donated partner inputs are baseline resources. $140k gross envelope includes $30k associated outside clinical inputs plus$10k other-portfolio outside allowance; it is not net induced societal spending. No current PHC accounts or sponsor fee verified.

evidence.transfer: .0375 central transfer is a subjective prior, not an identified causal correction. Missing-as-no-benefit sensitivity included.
.02 utility is an explicit prior; neither questionnaire points nor the abstract .017 QALYs are imported as a per-year local rate.

evidence.design: Randomized immediate versus delayed domiciliary dentures
evidence.transfer: .03 generic utility and one-year use are priors, not OIDP-to-QALY conversion.

comparisonBridge.headline: Historical program result preserved, not added
comparisonBridge.body: The old $71,111 donor/10Q glasses calculation assumes every dollar buys completed pairs at$100. It also jointly discounts funding/access; no whole-portfolio allocation or outside resources were priced.
comparisonBridge.boundary: Original JSON preserved byte-for-byte as a historical artifact. Do not add its QALYs to the portfolio result or claim general donations restricted to glasses.

reservations: No current PHC accounts, additional dispense commitment or sponsor fee verified.
Generic utility differences can overlap; primary-patient ledger exclusions are essential and unverified locally.
Positive central components do not demonstrate all services effective; unmodeled benefits and harms may change the estimate.
An external hearing/dental trial is not evidence that PHC's gift causes the same treatment intensity or follow-up.
Outside-resource allowances are uncertain and count gross associated activity even if funding substitutes.
excludedBenefits: Basic dental pain treatment outside denture cohort
Drop-in support, IDs and broader navigation health
Mortality, housing, employment and income effects
Separate social/mental-health gains already potentially inside generic utility
Health after the one-year post-care-start cap
Other-provider QALYs already counted for the same patient/year

sources.sourceType: 133 older edentate adults; immediate dentures versus deferred usual waiting list with visits; three-month OIDP improvements, not preference utility.

sources.sourceType: Current DHCS FAQ delays affected existing adult non-emergency dental benefit loss to July 1, 2027; new restricted-scope applicants and exceptions differ. Coverage is not realized access.
